title: Configured max_turns is discarded during agent construction
reasoning: The configuration accepts max_turns, but _from_config neither passes it to the constructor nor translates it into extra_args or settings. The constructed agent therefore cannot distinguish configurations with different turn limits, silently ignoring the requested execution bound.
reproduction: Construct agents from otherwise identical configurations with max_turns set to different positive values. Both receive identical execution configuration.
recommendation: Carry max_turns through agent construction and apply it to the CLI invocation.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included; existing coverage of configuration propagation cannot be verified.
suggestedRegressionTest: Exercise configuration-to-command propagation for several turn limits and the unset case, asserting that the resulting invocation preserves the configured bound.
minimumFixScope: ClaudeCodeConfig-to-ClaudeCodeAgent propagation and CLI argument construction.
